## TypeScript Package Bug Report

Use this template for the npm packages built from `typescript/`: `@ahoo-wang/wow-client`, `@ahoo-wang/wow-react`, `@ahoo-wang/wow-generator` and `@ahoo-wang/wow-view-engine`. For the Kotlin/JVM modules, use the Bug Report template instead.

Before reporting a bug, make sure you have:

- Searched the open and closed [GitHub issues](https://github.com/Ahoo-Wang/Wow/issues).
- Read the [Wow documentation](https://wow.ahoo.me/).

Please monitor the issue after submitting it because maintainers may need more details.
If the problem cannot be reproduced with the available information and no additional details are provided, the issue may be closed.

### Environment

- npm package(s) and version(s) (for example `@ahoo-wang/wow-client@9.2.0`; `npm ls @ahoo-wang/wow-client` prints it):
- Runtime (Node.js version, or browser name and version):
- Bundler and version (for example Vite 8, webpack 5, none):
- React version (for `wow-react` and `wow-view-engine`):
- Wow server version the client talks to:
- For `wow-generator`: the command you ran and how the OpenAPI document was obtained:
